newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse dips in lighter trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse dips in lighter trade.

text.p: Estonia's bourse eased in lighter trade on Friday, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 10.4 million kroons versus 17.8 million kroons on Thursday and the index fell 0.77 percent to 108.99.
Savings Bank accounted for the lion's share of the day's activity at 4.8 million kroons and its shares slid to 48.65 kroons from 50.30 kroons.
Market leader Hansa bank also lost ground, falling to 108.10 kroons from 108.70 kroons.
Volume on the secondary list was 2.8 million kroons.
